name: andock
description: Connect your mailbox from most email providers. Get a briefing of new mail, see who waits for your reply, follow up on quotes and invoices, and write drafts.

interface.longDescription: Connect the mailbox you already have, from most email providers, and work with it in ChatGPT. Get a short briefing of what came in, see who is waiting for your reply and who has not answered you, follow up on open quotes and invoices, find facts in old mail, and let ChatGPT write drafts. Mail is only sent when you ask, and sending can require your approval through a link.

positive.prompt: What needs my attention in my inbox?
positive.expected_behavior: Sorts the last days of mail: Maria Keller's two questions on the quote under needs reply, Sam Rivera and Ruedi Meier as first contacts, and the receipt, newsletter and cc mail grouped separately.

positive.prompt: Who is still waiting for my reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists conversations waiting for the user, with Maria Keller (two questions on the website quote) at the top.
Lists Tom Brunner (invoice 2026-031) and Lea Schmid (brochure proposal). Lea's out-of-office reply does not count as an answer.

positive.description: Find a fact in old mail
positive.prompt: What budget did Tom confirm for the rebrand?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Tom Brunner's mail and answers CHF 8,400 with final files due by 15 December, naming the mail it came from.

positive.prompt: Draft a reply to Maria: two phases are fine and I can start on 1 December.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves a short reply to Maria Keller in the Drafts folder of the demo mailbox. Nothing is sent.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Zurich tomorrow?
Write a short poem about autumn.
Create a spreadsheet of my monthly budget.

review.commerce_description: Andock does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds the review test cases, a shorter subtitle and a description that fits every provider. ChatGPT now asks only for the profile and email scopes when you connect.
